title: Remove temperature sensor and wash heater (W8178558 §4-22)

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Washer (Job Aid L-78)
source.sourceExcerpt: REMOVING THE TEMPERATURE SENSOR & HEATER — service manual §4-22 (temperature sensor and heater removal).

safety.safetyWarning: Electrical Shock Hazard — Failure to do so can result in death or electrical shock.

source.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard — Disconnect power before servicing.

safety.instruction: Replace all parts and panels before operating.
safety.safetyWarning: Electrical Shock Hazard — Failure to do so can result in death or electrical shock.

source.sourceExcerpt: Replace all parts and panels before operating.

beforeRepairChecks.instruction: Turn off the water supply to the washer.

source.sourceExcerpt: 2. Turn off the water supply to the washer.

beforeRepairChecks.instruction: Pull the washer away from the wall.

source.sourceExcerpt: 3. Pull the washer away from the wall.

beforeRepairChecks.instruction: Remove the rear panel from the washer (see page 4-20 for the procedure).

source.sourceExcerpt: 4. Remove the rear panel from the washer (see page 4-20 for the procedure).

steps.instruction: To remove the temperature sensor: a) Disconnect the wire connector from the temperature sensor. b) Loosen the 10 mm nut and pull the temperature sensor out of the heater.

source.sourceExcerpt: 5. To remove the temperature sensor: a) Disconnect the wire connector from the temperature sensor. b) Loosen the 10 mm nut and pull the temperature sensor out of the heater.

steps.instruction: To remove the heater: a) Remove the temperature sensor from the heater (see step 5). b) Loosen (do not remove) the 10 mm nut on the heater. c) Disconnect the two wires and the ground connector wire from the heater. d) Pull the heater out of the tub opening.

source.sourceExcerpt: 6. To remove the heater: a) Remove the temperature sensor from the heater (see step 5). b) Loosen (do not remove) the 10 mm nut on the heater. c) Disconnect the two wires and the ground connector wire from the heater. d) Pull the heater out of the tub opening.
